scope: Bounded primary-source cycling, running, triathlon pacing/weather/fueling comparison; not exhaustive internet coverage.
method: Broad web discovery followed by primary docs and GitHub API tree/license/source inspection. No stars used as accuracy evidence. No installation, account signup, external upload or application changes.
